India and Armenia Sign Defence Innovation Pact

India and Armenia have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) focused on innovation and shared production within the defence industry. The agreement was formalized following a meeting between India's Defence Secretary and Armenian Defence Minister Suren Papikyan in Yerevan. The discussions aimed to explore avenues for strengthening bilateral defence cooperation between the two nations.
